# Spack site-level packages configuration.
#
# This file is installed to the Spack site configuration directory
# (/etc/spack/packages.yaml) during the container build so that all
# environments and ad-hoc installs inherit these settings without
# needing to repeat them in every spack.yaml.
#
# Design notes:
#   - All packages default to target derived from PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET (amd64->x86_64_v3, arm64->aarch64)
#     and compiler gcc@13. This covers root's own dependencies (e.g. zlib, python, xrootd)
#     which do not need to share the gcc@15 ABI of root itself.
#   - root and its dependents (phlex) require gcc@15; those overrides
#     live in each environment's spack.yaml, not here.
#   - System zlib is declared external so Spack does not build its own
#     zlib / zlib-ng, eliminating duplicate virtual-provider builds.
#   - PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET must be set at build time to either "amd64" or "arm64"
#     to select the appropriate microarchitecture.

packages:
  all:
    require:
      - target=${PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET:-x86_64_v3}
    providers:
      "zlib-api:": [zlib]

  c:
    prefer: ["gcc@13"]
  cxx:
    prefer: ["gcc@13"]
  fortran:
    prefer: ["gcc@13"]

  # Use the system zlib rather than building zlib / zlib-ng from source.
  # The external entry must match the Ubuntu 24.04 package layout.
  zlib:
    externals:
      - spec: zlib@1.3
        prefix: /usr
    buildable: false
  zlib-ng:
    buildable: false
```

# Install GitHub's act CLI for local workflow testing

if [ "${INSTALL_ACT}" != "true" ]; then

apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends gh
apt-get clean
rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
INSTALL_GH_CLI

# --- Mode-specific implementations ---

# mode_default - standard execution with PHLEX_HOST_RELAY_PORTS
mode_default() {
  echo "Running in default mode with PHLEX_HOST_RELAY_PORTS"

  if [ -n "${PHLEX_HOST_RELAY_PORTS:-}" ]; then
    if ! parse_and_validate_relays "$PHLEX_HOST_RELAY_PORTS"; then
      write_relay_maps
      return 1
    fi

    local -a ready_source_ports=()
    local -a ready_dest_ports=()
    local source_count=0
    if [ -n "${valid_source_ports[*]-}" ]; then
      source_count=${#valid_source_ports[@]}
    fi
    for ((i = 0; i < source_count; i++)); do
      if start_relay "${valid_source_ports[$i]}" "${valid_dest_ports[$i]}"; then
        ready_source_ports+=("${valid_source_ports[$i]}")
        ready_dest_ports+=("${valid_dest_ports[$i]}")
      fi
    done
    valid_source_ports=("${ready_source_ports[@]-}")
    valid_dest_ports=("${ready_dest_ports[@]-}")

    write_relay_maps

    export PHLEX_HOST_RELAY_FILE="$RELAY_MAP_JSON"
    export PHLEX_HOST_RELAYS_ENV="$RELAY_MAP_ENV"
  else
    echo "No PHLEX_HOST_RELAY_PORTS configured; using defaults"
    valid_source_ports=()
    valid_dest_ports=()
    write_relay_maps
  fi
}

# mode_self_test - run self-test in external directory
mode_self_test() {

    local actual=0
    if [ -n "${valid_source_ports[*]-}" ]; then
      actual=${#valid_source_ports[@]}

    if [ "$actual" -ne "$expected" ]; then

  RELAY_MAP_JSON="${test_state_dir}/relay-map.json"
  RELAY_MAP_ENV="${test_state_dir}/relay-map.env"
  RELAY_PID_DIR="${test_state_dir}/pids"

  # Start disposable listeners on the two allowlisted source ports.
  echo "Setting up test listeners on 25114 and 25300..."
  local fakelistener
  fakelistener() {
    local port=$1
    python3 -c "
import socket, time
s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
s.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
s.bind(('127.0.0.1', $port))
s.listen(1)
time.sleep(5)
" 2>/dev/null &
  }
  fakelistener 25114
  fakelistener 25300
  sleep 0.5

  # Test 1: Positive case - valid mappings
  echo "Test 1: Valid relay mappings (25114=25115,25300=25301)"
  parse_and_validate_relays "25114=25115,25300=25301"
  local valid_count=${#valid_source_ports[@]}
  echo "  Valid pairs found: $valid_count (expected 2)"
  assert_valid_count 2 || failed=1

  # Test 2: Malformed input
  echo "Test 2: Malformed input (non-numeric and ports < 1024)"
  valid_source_ports=()
  valid_dest_ports=()
  parse_and_validate_relays "abc=def,123=456"
  echo "  Valid pairs found: ${#valid_source_ports[@]} (expected 0)"
  assert_valid_count 0 || failed=1

  # Test 3: Duplicate source
  echo "Test 3: Duplicate source port (25114=25115,25114=25116)"
  valid_source_ports=()
  valid_dest_ports=()
  parse_and_validate_relays "25114=25115,25114=25116"
  echo "  Valid pairs found: ${#valid_source_ports[@]} (expected 0)"
  assert_valid_count 0 || failed=1

  # Test 4: Privileged port (< 1024)

  valid_dest_ports=()
  parse_and_validate_relays "80=8080,1024=11024"
  echo "  Valid pairs found: ${#valid_source_ports[@]} (expected 0 - 80 is privileged and 1024 not listening)"
  assert_valid_count 0 || failed=1

  # Test 5: Equal source and dest port
  echo "Test 5: Equal source and dest port (25114=25114)"
  valid_source_ports=()
  valid_dest_ports=()
  parse_and_validate_relays "25114=25114,25300=25301"
  echo "  Valid pairs found: ${#valid_source_ports[@]} (expected 0)"
  assert_valid_count 0 || failed=1

  # Test 6: Unavailable source (port not listening)
  echo "Test 6: Unavailable source port (9999=19999)"
  valid_source_ports=()
  valid_dest_ports=()
  parse_and_validate_relays "9999=19999"
  echo "  Valid pairs found: ${#valid_source_ports[@]} (expected 0)"
  assert_valid_count 0 || failed=1

  # Test 7: Deterministic map ordering (reverse order should produce same result)
  echo "Test 7: Deterministic map ordering (reverse order should produce same result)"
  valid_source_ports=()
  valid_dest_ports=()
  parse_and_validate_relays "25300=25301,25114=25115"
  write_relay_maps

  if [ -f "$RELAY_MAP_JSON" ]; then
    local json_content
    json_content=$(cat "$RELAY_MAP_JSON")
    echo "  JSON content: $json_content"
  fi

  if [ -f "$RELAY_MAP_ENV" ]; then
    local env_content
    env_content=$(cat "$RELAY_MAP_ENV")
    echo "  ENV lines: $(echo "$env_content" | grep -c . 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
    echo "  ENV content:"
    cat "$RELAY_MAP_ENV" | sed 's/^/    /'
  fi

  # Test 8: Cleanup function
  echo "Test 8: Cleanup function"
  echo "12345" > "${test_state_dir}/pids/25114"
  if is_pid_owned_by_us "${test_state_dir}/pids/25114" "25114" "25115"; then
    echo "  PID ownership: CORRECTLY REJECTED (12345 is not a socat process)"
  else
    echo "  PID ownership: CORRECTLY FAILED (fake PID not a real process)"
  fi

  echo "Self-test completed"
  return "$failed"
}

# mode_cleanup_owned - cleanup only processes owned by this relay system
mode_cleanup_owned() {
  echo "Cleaning up owned relay processes"

  if [ ! -d "$RELAY_PID_DIR" ]; then
    echo "No PID directory found: $RELAY_PID_DIR"
    exit 0
  fi

  for pidfile in "$RELAY_PID_DIR"/*; do
    if [ -f "$pidfile" ]; then
      local source_port
      source_port=$(basename "$pidfile")
      cleanup_owned_process "$pidfile" "$source_port"
    fi
  done

  # Clean up empty PID directory
  rmdir "$RELAY_PID_DIR" 2>/dev/null || true

  echo "Cleanup completed"
}

# --- Main execution ---

# Fixture and cleanup modes must not clone repositories, create bind mounts,
# inspect Podman, or create production relay state.
case "$MODE" in
  self-test)
    mode_self_test
    exit $?
    ;;
  cleanup-owned)
    mode_cleanup_owned
    exit $?
    ;;
  start-test-services)
    mode_start_test_services
    exit $?
    ;;
esac

USER_ID=$(id -u)
PODMAN_REAL_SOCKET="${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/run/user/${USER_ID}}/podman/podman.sock"
PROXY_DIR="${HOME}/.podman-proxy"
PROXY_SOCKET="${PROXY_DIR}/podman.sock"

ensure_bind_dir -m 0700 "${PROXY_DIR}"

if [ -S "${PODMAN_REAL_SOCKET}" ]; then
  start_socat_relay \
    "Podman socket" \
    "socat UNIX-LISTEN:${PROXY_SOCKET}" \
    "UNIX-LISTEN:${PROXY_SOCKET},fork,reuseaddr,unlink-early" \
    "UNIX-CONNECT:${PODMAN_REAL_SOCKET}" \
    "/tmp/socat-podman.log" \
    "[ -S '${PROXY_SOCKET}' ]" || true
else
  echo "WARNING: Podman socket not found at ${PODMAN_REAL_SOCKET}" >&2
  echo "  To use 'act' inside the devcontainer, enable the Podman socket:" >&2
  echo "    systemctl --user enable --now podman.socket" >&2
fi

if [ ! -S "${PROXY_SOCKET}" ]; then
  python3 -c "
import socket, os
s = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX)
s.bind('${PROXY_SOCKET}')
" 2>/dev/null || touch "${PROXY_SOCKET}"
fi

# --- Headroom Proxy Relays for Devcontainer ---
HEADROOM_AZURE_PORT="${HEADROOM_AZURE_PORT:-9797}"
HEADROOM_OW_PORT="${HEADROOM_OW_PORT:-9798}"

relay_headroom_port() {
  local role="$1"
  local proxy_port="$2"
  local relay_port=$(( proxy_port + 10000 ))
  local local_addr="127.0.0.1:${proxy_port}"

  if ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null | grep -q "127.0.0.1:${proxy_port}"; then
    start_socat_relay \
      "Headroom ${role} proxy" \
      "socat TCP-LISTEN:${relay_port}" \
      "TCP-LISTEN:${relay_port},fork,reuseaddr" \
      "TCP:${local_addr}" \
      "/tmp/socat-headroom-${role}.log" \
      "ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null | grep -q ':${relay_port} '" || true
  else
    echo "WARNING: headroom ${role} proxy not detected at ${local_addr}; skipping relay" >&2
    echo "  Ensure the SSH tunnel is active (headroom-${role} running on your laptop)" >&2
  fi
}

relay_headroom_port azure "${HEADROOM_AZURE_PORT}"
relay_headroom_port ow "${HEADROOM_OW_PORT}"

# Ensure remaining source bind mount points exist.
ensure_bind_dir "$HOME/.config/"{gh,kilo}
ensure_bind_dir -m 0700 "$HOME/.gnupg"
ensure_bind_dir -m 0700 "$HOME/.vscode-remote-user-data"
ensure_bind_dir -m 0700 "$HOME/.local/share/kilo"
ensure_bind_dir -m 0700 "$HOME/.phlex-devcontainer-tmp"

# Execute the normal host setup after the legacy repository and Podman setup.
if ! mode_default; then
  echo "ERROR: relay configuration rejected; no relay map was admitted" >&2
  exit 1
fi

# Darwin-specific relay binding with --net=pasta guard
if [[ "$OSTYPE" == "darwin"* ]]; then
  VM_SOCKET_PATH="${PODMAN_REAL_SOCKET:-${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/run/user/$(id -u)}/podman/podman.sock}"
  PODMAN_IN_USE=false

  if command -v podman >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    if podman machine list 2>/dev/null | grep -qE 'Running|Started'; then
      if podman machine ssh test -S "$VM_SOCKET_PATH" 2>/dev/null; then
        export PHLEX_PODMAN_SOCKET_SOURCE="podman-machine:ssh"
        export PHLEX_DEV_NETWORK_MODE="pasta"
        export PHLEX_HOST_GATEWAY="host.docker.internal"
        PODMAN_IN_USE=true
      else
        echo "WARNING: Darwin podman machine socket not accessible via 'podman machine ssh -S'" >&2
        echo "  Tested path: $VM_SOCKET_PATH" >&2
        echo "  Nested container support (act) may not work" >&2
        export PHLEX_PODMAN_SOCKET_SOURCE="podman-machine:missing"
        export PHLEX_DEV_NETWORK_MODE="pasta"
        export PHLEX_HOST_GATEWAY="host.docker.internal"
      fi
    else
      if [ -S "$VM_SOCKET_PATH" ]; then
        export PHLEX_PODMAN_SOCKET_SOURCE="host:direct"
        export PHLEX_DEV_NETWORK_MODE="pasta"
        export PHLEX_HOST_GATEWAY="host.docker.internal"
        PODMAN_IN_USE=true
      else
        echo "WARNING: Darwin socket not found at $VM_SOCKET_PATH" >&2
        echo "  Nested container support (act) may not work" >&2
        export PHLEX_PODMAN_SOCKET_SOURCE="host:missing"
        export PHLEX_DEV_NETWORK_MODE="pasta"
        export PHLEX_HOST_GATEWAY="host.docker.internal"
      fi
    fi
  else
    echo "WARNING: podman not found - assuming no Podman usage" >&2
    export PHLEX_PODMAN_SOCKET_SOURCE="none"
    export PHLEX_DEV_NETWORK_MODE="pasta"
    export PHLEX_HOST_GATEWAY="host.docker.internal"
  fi
else
  export PHLEX_PODMAN_SOCKET_SOURCE="host:direct"
  export PHLEX_DEV_NETWORK_MODE="bridge"
  export PHLEX_HOST_GATEWAY="host.containers.internal"
fi

echo "SUCCESS: .devcontainer/ensure-repos.sh completed successfully"

# Native arm64 Podman blocker repair

## Goal

Repair the blocking implementation and evidence defects identified by the implementation-alignment review of `1788724605364-native-arm64-podman-continuation-v4.md`, then obtain a fresh clean or non-blocking alignment review and produce a receipt-grade static handoff. This plan does not claim native arm64 Spack, C++23, image, Podman, pasta, rootless, or end-to-end devcontainer acceptance.

## Scope

Use the current worktree as the repair baseline and preserve all unrelated pre-existing changes. Repair only `ci/Dockerfile`, `ci/spack.yaml`, `ci/packages.yaml`, `ci/entrypoint.sh`, `.devcontainer/ensure-repos.sh`, and `.devcontainer/kilo-env.sh`. Bind the prior v4 source, direct state, blocked review, and evidence as read-only provenance; create a new evidence run and new direct state for this source. Verify the complete producer-to-consumer relay/Kilo contract with disposable external fixtures and record all static and unavailable-runtime results under the new run directory.

## Exclusions

Do not resume, reset, or modify the v3 or v4 direct states, v3/v4 source files, v4 review ledger, legacy state, `.exec.json` artifacts, or the retired Plan/Compile/Execute workflow. Do not modify `.kilo/kilo.jsonc`, `.github/workflows/*`, `.actrc`, `CMakePresets.json`, `scripts/git-ai-commit`, `scripts/test/test_git_ai_commit.py`, `.devcontainer/post-create.sh`, `.devcontainer/devcontainer.json`, any host credential or socket path, or any path outside a step allowlist. Do not initialize or mutate Podman machines, build or push images, use wildcard or TCP relays, create production relay fixtures during tests, commit, or push. Do not claim that absent devcontainer mounts or native runtime checks are repaired by this plan.

## Steps

### provenance. Bind prior blocked review and new repair state

Verify that v3 and v4 are provenance only, that the v4 source and state are not being resumed, and that `.kilo/plans/evidence/20260904T151641Z-v3-545de7544a/step-1-values.env` remains prior evidence only and is marked `unavailable` unless independently revalidated in this invocation. The prior directory has no companion hash file; compute the artifact hash in this invocation and record it as newly derived evidence, not as a preserved prior receipt. Keep the raw build input separate from normalized `PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET` and `PHLEX_LLVM_TARGET`, source the normalized carrier before every Spack operation that can consume those values, and render only the build-time copies of the architecture-neutral tracked Spack descriptors before `spack config`, `spack env create`, or concretization. ### relay. Repair Darwin-safe fail-closed relay lifecycle and evidence

#### Depends on

- architecture

#### Executor

coder-qwen

#### Capabilities

- filesystem
- shell
- tool:bash

#### Allowed files

- .devcontainer/ensure-repos.sh

#### Prohibited changes

- all paths in Exclusions
- `.devcontainer/kilo-env.sh`
- wildcard listeners, arbitrary port scans, TCP APIs, host interface mutation, production relay fixtures, and unowned-process termination

#### Task

Repair the relay producer without restoring unrelated legacy behavior. Keep the exact allowlist and state contract: default `$HOME/.phlex-devcontainer-tmp/relays`, sorted `relay-map.json`, one `PHLEX_HOST_RELAY_<source>=<relay>` line per mapping, and the named mappings `25114=25115,25300=25301`. Run fixture tests only in an invocation-unique external directory and return their output and hashes to the orchestrator. Make Darwin execution work with system Bash 3.2 and without requiring util-linux `setsid`; keep Linux behavior intact. Parse the complete input before starting anything and fail closed with empty maps, no new relay, and nonzero status for malformed, duplicate, privileged, equal, unavailable, or unlisted mappings. Start listener-first, admit a mapping only after the relay is ready, and remove failed starts before writing maps. Use only exact Darwin `lsof` or Linux `ss` listener checks. Replace any pattern-based termination for the numeric relay path with PID-file command-identity proof, prevent empty-array nounset failures, and ensure `--cleanup-owned` cannot kill unrelated processes. Keep host-dependent socket/VM/pasta checks conditional on fresh provenance; otherwise report `unavailable` and continue only with fixtures. Existing relay edits that already satisfy these requirements must be verified with hashes and left unchanged; do not regenerate the file wholesale.

#### Context

The v4 alignment review found that the relay implementation still had Darwin `setsid` and Bash 3.2 hazards, discarded startup failures while writing maps, swallowed invalid-input status, and had self-tests that printed expected counts without asserting them. It also identified pattern-based cleanup in the legacy Podman/Headroom helper and unreliable PID ownership as risks. The repair must preserve partial edits and never restore the whole file.

#### Acceptance criteria

- Darwin Bash 3.2 and Linux syntax paths execute without `setsid` or empty-array failures.

```
#!/bin/bash

# Disable Spack's user scope to prevent user-level config interference
export SPACK_USER_CONFIG_PATH=/dev/null
export SPACK_DISABLE_LOCAL_CONFIG=true

if [ -f /etc/profile.d/phlex-targets.sh ]; then
  . /etc/profile.d/phlex-targets.sh
fi

: "${PHLEX_SPACK_ENV:=/opt/spack-environments/phlex-ci}"
# PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET must be normalized to x86_64_v3 or aarch64 (Dockerfile handles this)
# Default is x86_64_v3 for backward compatibility
: "${PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET:=x86_64_v3}"
# CI images use GCC as default; developer images use Clang with GCC 15 toolchain for reproducible gcc@15 ABI
: "${PHLEX_DEFAULT_COMPILER:=gcc}"

# Validate PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET is normalized (x86_64_v3 or aarch64)
# Dockerfile normalizes amd64->x86_64_v3 and arm64->aarch64 before this runs
case "$PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET" in
  x86_64_v3)
    : "${PHLEX_LLVM_TARGET:=x86}"
    ;;
  aarch64)
    : "${PHLEX_LLVM_TARGET:=AArch64}"
    ;;
  *)
    echo "ERROR: PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET must be 'x86_64_v3' or 'aarch64'" >&2
    echo "       Got: '$PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET'" >&2
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

# Validate that SPACK target and LLVM target are compatible (no x86_64_v3 + AArch64, no aarch64 + x86)
case "$PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET-$PHLEX_LLVM_TARGET" in
  x86_64_v3-AArch64|aarch64-x86)
    echo "ERROR: Host/target mismatch: PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET=$PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET with PHLEX_LLVM_TARGET=$PHLEX_LLVM_TARGET" >&2
    exit 1
    ;;
  *)
    # Valid combinations: x86_64_v3+x86, aarch64+AArch64
    ;;
esac

. /spack/share/spack/setup-env.sh
spack env activate -d "$PHLEX_SPACK_ENV"

# GCC 15 is required for Phlex and its direct dependencies.
# The Spack view's 'bin' directory contains symlinks to the active compiler.
# When PHLEX_DEFAULT_COMPILER is "gcc", use GCC 15 directly via PATH.
# When PHLEX_DEFAULT_COMPILER is "clang", use Clang with reproducible --gcc-toolchain binding.
if [ "$PHLEX_DEFAULT_COMPILER" = "gcc" ]; then
  # Developer can override CC/CXX via environment; CI uses explicit --target mapping
  # GCC 15 must be used for phlex, root, and their dependencies to share ABI.
  # The spack env activate makes gcc@15 available from the Spack view.
  PATH=$(spack -E location -i gcc@15 %c,cxx=gcc@13)/bin:$PATH
  export CC=gcc CXX=g++
else
  # clang/clang++ with reproducible --gcc-toolchain binding to GCC 15
  # This preserves the GCC 15 ABI while allowing compilation via Clang.
  # The --gcc-toolchain option ensures Clang uses GCC 15's libstdc++ and headers.
  gcc_path=$(spack location -i gcc@15 %c,cxx=gcc@13)
  export CC=clang CXX=clang++
  export CFLAGS="--gcc-toolchain=$gcc_path"
  export CXXFLAGS="--gcc-toolchain=$gcc_path"
fi
```

### architecture. Repair persistent normalized Spack rendering and compiler defaults

#### Depends on

#### Executor

- tool:bash

#### Allowed files

#### Prohibited changes

- all paths in Exclusions
- CMakePresets.json and protected baseline paths
- image builds, pushes, machine mutation, and cross-architecture cache or binary reuse

#### Task

Repair the CI configuration so normalized architecture values are effective in every architecture-dependent Spack operation, not merely exported in an isolated Docker `RUN` layer. Keep the raw build input separate from normalized `PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET` and `PHLEX_LLVM_TARGET`, source the normalized carrier before every Spack operation that can consume those values, and render only the build-time copies of the architecture-neutral tracked Spack descriptors before `spack config`, `spack env create`, or concretization. Rendering must replace only the three known `${PHLEX_*_TARGET:-default}` expressions with the carrier's validated literal values and must fail if an expected expression is absent or remains after rendering; do not use unbounded environment substitution. Do not remove the architecture-neutral template defaults from tracked `ci/spack.yaml` or `ci/packages.yaml`; non-Docker consumers such as `dev/jules/prepare-environment.sh` must remain unaffected. Prove both amd64 and arm64 source inputs produce exactly `x86_64_v3`/`x86` and `aarch64`/`AArch64`, and prove mismatched native host/target combinations fail before Spack cloning. Preserve GCC 15 ABI constraints, Fermilab mirrors, CI GCC default, developer Clang default, a functional explicit GCC override, reproducible Clang `--gcc-toolchain`, and act/tracebox architecture behavior. Validate `PHLEX_DEFAULT_COMPILER` as exactly `gcc` or `clang` rather than treating every non-GCC value as Clang. Leave native concretization unavailable when Spack is absent rather than claiming it passed. Existing target-related edits that already satisfy these requirements must be verified with hashes and left unchanged; do not regenerate whole files or regions.

#### Context

The previous v4 review confirmed early argument scope and a persistent target carrier but identified unresolved questions about Spack’s handling of `${VAR:-default}` in YAML, one unsourced Spack layer, and the developer-stage compiler override. The repair must remove reliance on unproven config interpolation for the static Docker build contract by rendering build-time copies, while retaining architecture-neutral tracked templates and a clearly recorded native-concretization check for the later arm64 gate.

#### Acceptance criteria

- The Docker stage declares build arguments in the stage where they are consumed and rejects host/target mismatches before any Spack clone, install, configuration, environment creation, or concretization.
- The copied Spack descriptors used by configuration and concretization contain the exact normalized target values for both inputs and no unresolved target-default expressions.
- Tracked Spack descriptors remain architecture-neutral templates with valid defaults, and non-Docker consumers remain unaffected; only Docker build-time copies are rendered.
- Every target-dependent Spack layer sources or consumes the same normalized carrier; the developer-stage Clang default and explicit GCC override both remain functional; invalid compiler selections fail explicitly.
- GCC 15 ABI, mirror, LLVM AArch64, act, tracebox, and reproducible Clang toolchain behavior remain present.
- Protected baseline files remain byte-identical.

#### Verification

- Run `bash -n` and `shellcheck -S warning` on `ci/entrypoint.sh`.
- Run a static two-input Dockerfile and descriptor-rendering matrix covering scope, early mismatch rejection, exact normalized values, LLVM selection, compiler defaults, and override behavior.
- Recompute protected hashes and run `git diff --check`, distinguishing pre-existing unrelated diagnostics from new findings.
- If native Spack is unavailable, record native descriptor rendering, concretization, and C++23 compilation as `unavailable`.
- Return command output, per-file pre/post hashes, and unchanged-region hashes to the orchestrator; the dependent evidence step writes the durable receipt before the next implementation dispatch. Do not regenerate already-satisfied regions.

### relay. Repair Darwin-safe fail-closed relay lifecycle and evidence

#### Depends on

- tool:bash

#### Task

Repair the relay producer without restoring unrelated legacy behavior. Keep the exact allowlist and state contract: default `$HOME/.phlex-devcontainer-tmp/relays`, sorted `relay-map.json`, one `PHLEX_HOST_RELAY_<source>=<relay>` line per mapping, and the named mappings `25114=25115,25300=25301`. Run fixture tests only in an invocation-unique external directory and return their output and hashes to the orchestrator. Make Darwin execution work with system Bash 3.2 and without requiring util-linux `setsid`; keep Linux behavior intact. Parse the complete input before starting anything and fail closed with empty maps, no new relay, and nonzero status for malformed, duplicate, privileged, equal, unavailable, or unlisted mappings. Start listener-first, admit a mapping only after the relay is ready, and remove failed starts before writing maps. Use only exact Darwin `lsof` or Linux `ss` listener checks. Remove the shared helper's `pkill -f` pre-start cleanup rather than replacing it with another pattern-based terminator. Numeric relay cleanup must instead use PID-file command-identity proof, prevent empty-array nounset failures, and ensure `--cleanup-owned` cannot kill unrelated processes. Keep host-dependent socket/VM/pasta checks conditional on fresh provenance; otherwise report `unavailable` and continue only with fixtures. Existing relay edits that already satisfy these requirements must be verified with hashes and left unchanged; do not regenerate the file wholesale.

#### Context

The v4 alignment review found that the relay implementation still had Darwin `setsid` and Bash 3.2 hazards, discarded startup failures while writing maps, swallowed invalid-input status, and had self-tests that printed expected counts without asserting them. It also identified pattern-based cleanup in the legacy Podman/Headroom helper and unreliable PID ownership as risks. The repair must preserve partial edits and never restore the whole file.

#### Acceptance criteria

- Darwin Bash 3.2 and Linux syntax paths execute without `setsid` or empty-array failures.
- Invalid input fails closed before any numeric relay starts, emits empty deterministic maps, and returns nonzero.
- Maps contain only explicitly allowlisted services whose listeners are ready; failed starts are absent.
- The script contains no `pkill` or other pattern-based process termination. Numeric relay cleanup proves command identity and cannot terminate unrelated processes; repeated runs converge without duplicate listeners.
- `--self-test`, `--start-test-services`, and `--cleanup-owned` use disposable or declared state, assert every expected result, and return nonzero on failure without cloning repositories, inspecting Podman, or creating production fixtures in fixture mode.
- Darwin loopback binding and conditional pasta/rootless handling remain explicit; unavailable host values are never presented as live acceptance.

#### Verification

- Run `bash -n` and `shellcheck -S warning` on the changed script, requiring both to exit zero.
- In an invocation-unique external directory, test positive ready mappings, malformed input, duplicates, privileged/equal/unlisted/unavailable mappings, listener-start failure, deterministic ordering, named services, cleanup ownership, repeated self-test convergence, and no production-state creation.
- Verify the resulting map is the actual ready map later consumed by the Kilo fixture.
- Return command output, per-file pre/post hashes, fixture hashes, and unavailable native socket/pasta/rootless results to the orchestrator. The dependent `relay-evidence` step writes the durable receipt and exact retained carrier before `kilo` dispatch; do not regenerate already-satisfied regions.

The production path consumes only `/run/phlex-host-relays/relay-map.json`, `/run/phlex-host-relays/relay-map.env`, then the ordered read-only candidates `/run/phlex-host-relays/kilo.json` and `/run/phlex-host-relays/kilo.jsonc`. For the cross-step fixture, consume the read-only external materialization of the exact `relay-evidence` carrier supplied as `PHLEX_RELAY_FIXTURE_DIR`, require its recorded SHA-256 to match the carrier receipt, and do not synthesize a replacement map. Before exporting anything, validate the complete JSON and env maps as the same sorted allowlisted mapping set: exact `PHLEX_HOST_RELAY_<source>=<relay>` syntax, no duplicate keys, and a one-to-one match between both files. # ######################################################################
# In this environment, we specify that some packages be built with the
# native compiler (currently GCC 13 on Ubuntu 24.04), and others with
# the compiler required to build Phlex (currently GCC 15).
# ######################################################################

spack:
  specs:
    - phlex
    - catch2
    - cetmodules
    - cmake
    - lcov
    - ninja
    - py-gcovr
    - py-pytest-cov # Needed for Python coverage reports
    - py-pyyaml # Needed by run-clang-tidy --export-fixes to merge per-TU fix files
    - |
      llvm@22.1.8 +zstd +llvm_dylib +link_llvm_dylib ~lldb targets=${PHLEX_LLVM_TARGET:-x86}

  view:
    default:
      root: .spack-env/view
      link: all
      projections:
        zstd: "{name}-{version}/{compiler.name}-{compiler.version}/{hash}"

  concretizer:
    unify: true
    reuse:
      from:
        - type: external
        - type: local
        - type: buildcache

  packages:
    cmake:
      require:
        - "~qtgui"
        - "@4:"
        - "target=${PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET:-x86_64_v3}"

    llvm:
      require:
        - "target=${PHLEX_LLVM_TARGET:-x86}"
        - "%c,cxx=gcc@15"

    phlex:
      require:
        - "@develop"
        - "+form"
        - "cxxstd=23"
        - "%cxx=gcc@15"
        - "^intel-tbb@2023.0.0:"

    py-cython:
      require:
        - "build_system=python_pip"

    py-gcovr:
      require:
        - "build_system=python_pip"

    py-pytest-cov:
      require:
        - "build_system=python_pip"

    py-pyyaml:
      require:
        - "build_system=python_pip"

    # Temporary version pin for C-API `char const *` consistency
    python:
      require:
        - "@3.12"

    # root and its dependents (phlex) must be built with gcc@15 so
    # they share a single ABI.  root's own dependencies (e.g. zlib,
    # python, xrootd) inherit the gcc@13 site default instead.
    # ROOT should be built with the same version of the C++ standard
    # as will be used by Phlex (C++23 for now).
    root:
      require:
        - "~x" # No graphics libraries required
        - "cxxstd=23"
        - "%c,cxx=gcc@15"

# Spack site-level packages configuration.
#
# This file is installed to the Spack site configuration directory
# (/etc/spack/packages.yaml) during the container build so that all
# environments and ad-hoc installs inherit these settings without
# needing to repeat them in every spack.yaml.
#
# Design notes:
#   - All packages default to target derived from PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET (amd64->x86_64_v3, arm64->aarch64)
#     and compiler gcc@13. This covers root's own dependencies (e.g. zlib, python, xrootd)
#     which do not need to share the gcc@15 ABI of root itself.
#   - root and its dependents (phlex) require gcc@15; those overrides
#     live in each environment's spack.yaml, not here.
#   - System zlib is declared external so Spack does not build its own
#     zlib / zlib-ng, eliminating duplicate virtual-provider builds.
#   - PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET must be set at build time to either "amd64" or "arm64"
#     to select the appropriate microarchitecture.

packages:
  all:
    require:
      - target=${PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET:-x86_64_v3}
    providers:
      "zlib-api:": [zlib]

  c:
    prefer: ["gcc@13"]
  cxx:
    prefer: ["gcc@13"]
  fortran:
    prefer: ["gcc@13"]

  # Use the system zlib rather than building zlib / zlib-ng from source.
  # The external entry must match the Ubuntu 24.04 package layout.
  zlib:
    externals:
      - spec: zlib@1.3
        prefix: /usr
    buildable: false
  zlib-ng:
    buildable: false
```

#
#   The devcontainer.json already configures both the mount and the env
#   var automatically when using VS Code / GitHub Codespaces.
#   Host prerequisite: systemctl --user enable --now podman.socket

ARG GPG_KEY_ID

FROM ubuntu:24.04 AS base

# Build arguments must be redeclared in the stage where they are consumed.
ARG PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET=amd64
ARG PHLEX_LLVM_TARGET=x86
ARG PHLEX_DEFAULT_COMPILER=gcc

ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
ENV LANG=en_US.UTF-8
ENV LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8
ENV SPACK_USER_CONFIG_PATH=/dev/null
ENV SPACK_DISABLE_LOCAL_CONFIG=true
ENV PHLEX_SPACK_ENV=/opt/spack-environments/phlex-ci
ENV PHLEX_SPACK_SOURCE_TARGET=${PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET}
ENV PHLEX_DEFAULT_COMPILER=${PHLEX_DEFAULT_COMPILER}

SHELL ["/bin/bash", "-c"]

# Validate PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET is a recognized source or normalized value
# This check runs after ARG definitions and before any RUN that depends on the target
RUN <<'ARCH_MAP_VALIDATE'
set -euo pipefail
case "$PHLEX_SPACK_SOURCE_TARGET" in
  amd64|arm64|x86_64_v3|aarch64) ;;
  *)
    echo "ERROR: PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET must be 'amd64', 'arm64', 'x86_64_v3', or 'aarch64'" >&2
    echo "       Got: '$PHLEX_SPACK_SOURCE_TARGET'" >&2
    exit 1
    ;;
esac
ARCH_MAP_VALIDATE

########################################################################
# Install essential build tools, git, and Python

RUN <<'ARCHITECTURE_CHECK'
set -euo pipefail

# Validate that the container build host architecture matches the requested SPACK target
# This check runs early, before any Spack clone/install/concretization operations
NATIVE_ARCH=$(dpkg --print-architecture)
case "$NATIVE_ARCH" in
  amd64)
    if [ "$PHLEX_SPACK_SOURCE_TARGET" != "amd64" ] && [ "$PHLEX_SPACK_SOURCE_TARGET" != "x86_64_v3" ]; then
      echo "ERROR: Host architecture '$NATIVE_ARCH' does not match PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET='$PHLEX_SPACK_SOURCE_TARGET'" >&2
      echo "       CI images must be built for the host architecture" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    # Normalize amd64 to x86_64_v3 for Spack
    normalized_spack_target=x86_64_v3
    normalized_llvm_target=x86
    ;;
  arm64)
    if [ "$PHLEX_SPACK_SOURCE_TARGET" != "arm64" ] && [ "$PHLEX_SPACK_SOURCE_TARGET" != "aarch64" ]; then
      echo "ERROR: Host architecture '$NATIVE_ARCH' does not match PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET='$PHLEX_SPACK_SOURCE_TARGET'" >&2
      echo "       CI images must be built for the host architecture" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    # Normalize arm64 to aarch64 for Spack
    normalized_spack_target=aarch64
    normalized_llvm_target=AArch64
    ;;
  *)
    echo "ERROR: Unknown host architecture '$NATIVE_ARCH'" >&2
    exit 1
    ;;
esac
# RUN layers do not retain shell exports. Persist normalized values for later
# Spack operations instead of relying on Docker layer state.
printf 'export PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET=%q\nexport PHLEX_LLVM_TARGET=%q\n' \
  "$normalized_spack_target" "$normalized_llvm_target" > /etc/profile.d/phlex-targets.sh
chmod 644 /etc/profile.d/phlex-targets.sh
ARCHITECTURE_CHECK

RUN <<'INSTALL_ESSENTIALS'
set -euo pipefail

# Install locale support required by tooling and Spack
apt-get update
apt-get upgrade -y --no-install-recommends
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    ca-certificates \
    cmake \
    curl \
    file \
    git \
    gnupg \
    locales-all \
    libcurl4-openssl-dev \
    libssl-dev \
    libxslt1-dev \
    libxml2-dev \
    lsb-release \
    ninja-build \
    pkg-config \
    software-properties-common \
    sudo \
    unzip \
    zlib1g-dev

apt autoremove -y
apt-get clean
rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
INSTALL_ESSENTIALS

########################################################################
# Clone Spack checkout used by both CI and dev images

RUN <<'CLONE_SPACK'
set -euo pipefail

# Clone Spack checkout used by both CI and dev images
git clone https://github.com/spack/spack.git /spack
CLONE_SPACK

########################################################################
# Prepare shared group and directories for Spack data/cache

RUN <<'PREP_SPACK_GROUP'
set -euo pipefail

# Prepare shared group and directories for Spack data/cache
groupadd --gid 2000 spack
mkdir -p /opt/spack-stage /opt/spack-cache/downloads /opt/spack-cache/misc /opt/spack-environments
chgrp -R spack /spack /opt/spack-stage /opt/spack-cache /opt/spack-environments
chmod -R g+rwX /spack /opt/spack-stage /opt/spack-cache /opt/spack-environments
find /spack /opt/spack-stage /opt/spack-cache /opt/spack-environments -type d -exec chmod g+s {} +
PREP_SPACK_GROUP

########################################################################
# Configure Spack: add repos, compilers, externals, and cache locations

COPY packages.yaml /tmp/packages.yaml
COPY upgrade_repos.py /tmp/upgrade_repos.py

ENV GNUPGHOME=/run/gpg
ENV SPACK_GNUPGHOME=/run/gpg

RUN <<'SPACK_CONFIGURE_DEFAULTS'
set -euo pipefail

SPACK_REPO_ROOT=/opt/spack-repos
rm -rf "$SPACK_REPO_ROOT/fnal_art" "$SPACK_REPO_ROOT/phlex-spack-recipes" "$SPACK_REPO_ROOT/spack-packages"
mkdir -p "$SPACK_REPO_ROOT"
git clone --depth=1 https://github.com/FNALssi/fnal_art.git "$SPACK_REPO_ROOT/fnal_art"
git clone --depth=1 https://github.com/Framework-R-D/phlex-spack-recipes.git "$SPACK_REPO_ROOT/phlex-spack-recipes"
git clone https://github.com/spack/spack-packages.git "$SPACK_REPO_ROOT/spack-packages"
chgrp -R spack "$SPACK_REPO_ROOT"
chmod -R g+rwX "$SPACK_REPO_ROOT"
find "$SPACK_REPO_ROOT" -type d -exec chmod g+s {} +

. /spack/share/spack/setup-env.sh
. /etc/profile.d/phlex-targets.sh

# Other config settings
spack config --scope defaults add config:build_stage:/opt/spack-stage
spack config --scope defaults add config:source_cache:/opt/spack-cache/downloads
spack config --scope defaults add config:misc_cache:/opt/spack-cache/misc
spack config --scope defaults add config:install_tree:padded_length:255

# Find compilers (destination packages.yaml for Spack >=1.0)
spack --timestamp compiler find --scope site

# Install settings from our copied packages.yaml
spack config --scope site add -f /tmp/packages.yaml
rm -f /tmp/packages.yaml

# Discover externals
#
# - Python is excluded because the python provided by the system does
#   not necessarily include the Python.h header file.  We therefore need
#   Spack to build Python.
spack --timestamp external find --exclude python

# Configure recipe repos
spack repo add --scope site $SPACK_REPO_ROOT/phlex-spack-recipes/spack_repo/phlex
spack repo add --scope site $SPACK_REPO_ROOT/fnal_art/spack_repo/fnal_art
spack repo add --scope site $SPACK_REPO_ROOT/spack-packages/repos/spack_repo/builtin

spack repo list
chmod +x /tmp/upgrade_repos.py
spack python /tmp/upgrade_repos.py
rm -f /tmp/upgrade_repos.py
spack repo list
spack clean -m
spack audit configs

SPACK_CONFIGURE_DEFAULTS

########################################################################
# Configure binary mirrors used during installs

RUN <<'SPACK_CONFIGURE_MIRRORS'
set -euo pipefail

# Register binary caches for Spack installs and optional local cache volume.
# The local cache is added with --unsigned so that packages built in earlier
# layers (which may be unsigned) can be consumed without signature checks.
# buildcache keys installs the public verification keys advertised by all
# configured mirrors so that signed packages from those mirrors can be
# verified during subsequent installs.
. /spack/share/spack/setup-env.sh
. /etc/profile.d/phlex-targets.sh

spack mirror add --type binary phlex-ci-scisoft https://scisoft.fnal.gov/scisoft/spack-packages/phlex-dev

if [ -d "/build-cache" ]; then
  spack mirror add --type binary --unsigned phlex-dev-local /build-cache
fi

spack buildcache keys -it
SPACK_CONFIGURE_MIRRORS

########################################################################
# Ensure intel-tbb@2023.0.0 has a checksum in the Spack recipe

RUN <<'ENSURE_INTEL_TBB_CHECKSUM'
set -euo pipefail

# intel-tbb@2023.0.0 may not be present in the spack-packages recipe that
# was cloned above.  If spack versions -n lists it as "new" (not checksummed), fetch the archive
# and add its checksum to the package file so that Spack can install it.
. /spack/share/spack/setup-env.sh
. /etc/profile.d/phlex-targets.sh

if spack versions -n intel-tbb | grep -Fwq '2023.0.0'; then
  EDITOR=true spack checksum -ab intel-tbb 2023.0.0
fi
ENSURE_INTEL_TBB_CHECKSUM

########################################################################
# Use Spack to install the GCC we want to use

RUN <<'SPACK_INSTALL_GCC'
set -euo pipefail

# Install GCC outside the Phlex development environment.
. /spack/share/spack/setup-env.sh
. /etc/profile.d/phlex-targets.sh

# PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET is already normalized to x86_64_v3 or aarch64 by the
# early architecture check (before this layer runs).
GCC_TARGET="${PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET}"

spack --timestamp install --fail-fast -j "$(nproc)" \
      --no-check-signature \
      gcc@15.3 target="${GCC_TARGET}" \
      +binutils+graphite~nvptx+piclibs+strip \
      build_type=Release \
      languages=c,c++,fortran,lto \
      %c,cxx=gcc@13.3.0 # % must be LAST (along with ^ dependencies)

if [ -d "/build-cache" ]; then
  key_id=${GPG_KEY_ID:-$({ gpg --list-secret-keys --with-colons | grep -Ee '^sec' | cut -d: -f 5 | head -n1; } 2>/dev/null || true)}
  if [ -n "$key_id" ]; then
    key_args=(--key "${key_id}")
  else
    key_args=(-u)
  fi
  spack --timestamp buildcache create --allow-missing ${key_args[*]:+"${key_args[@]}"} -j $(nproc) --update-index \
        /build-cache $(spack find --no-groups -LI | \
        sed -Ene 's&^\[\+\] +([^[:space:]]+).*$&/\1&p')
fi

# Make GCC external to simplify concretization
spack compiler find $(spack location -i gcc@15)

spack clean -dfs
SPACK_INSTALL_GCC

########################################################################
# Create, activate, and concretize the phlex-ci Spack environment

COPY spack.yaml /tmp/spack.yaml
RUN <<'SPACK_CONCRETIZE_ENV'
set -euo pipefail

# Build the phlex-ci environment lockfile with consistent permissions
# PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET and PHLEX_LLVM_TARGET are already normalized by
# the early architecture check before this layer runs.

. /spack/share/spack/setup-env.sh
. /etc/profile.d/phlex-targets.sh

mkdir -p "$(dirname "$PHLEX_SPACK_ENV")"
rm -rf "$PHLEX_SPACK_ENV"
spack --timestamp env create -d "$PHLEX_SPACK_ENV" /tmp/spack.yaml
rm -f /tmp/spack.yaml
spack --timestamp env activate -d "$PHLEX_SPACK_ENV"
spack --timestamp concretize
chgrp -R spack "$PHLEX_SPACK_ENV"
chmod -R g+rwX "$PHLEX_SPACK_ENV"
find "$PHLEX_SPACK_ENV" -type d -exec chmod g+s {} +
SPACK_CONCRETIZE_ENV

########################################################################
# Install common tooling layer (CMake, Ninja, coverage tools, etc.)

COPY entrypoint.sh /entrypoint.sh

RUN <<'INSTALL_TOOLING_CORE'
set -euo pipefail

# Install core build utilities through Spack for both images
. /entrypoint.sh

# Recreate the environment view in this layer to avoid cross-layer rename
# failures (EXDEV) when Spack rotates view -> view.old.<hash>.
rm -rf "$PHLEX_SPACK_ENV/.spack-env/view"
rm -rf "$PHLEX_SPACK_ENV"/.spack-env/view.old.*


spack --timestamp install --fail-fast -j $(nproc) \
  --no-add --only-concrete --no-check-signature \
  cmake lcov ninja py-gcovr py-pytest-cov py-pyyaml

if [ -d "/build-cache" ]; then
  key_id=${GPG_KEY_ID:-$({ gpg --list-secret-keys --with-colons | grep -Ee '^sec' | cut -d: -f 5 | head -n1; } 2>/dev/null || true)}
  if [ -n "$key_id" ]; then
    key_args=(--key "${key_id}")
  else
    key_args=(-u)
  fi
  spack --timestamp buildcache create --allow-missing ${key_args[*]:+"${key_args[@]}"} -j $(nproc) --update-index \
        /build-cache $(spack find --no-groups -LI | \
        sed -Ene 's&^\[\+\] +([^[:space:]]+).*$&/\1&p')
fi

# Step 2 orchestrator verification after targeted remediation

Disposition: `inconclusive`

## Deterministic results

- `bash -n ci/entrypoint.sh`: exit 0
- `shellcheck ci/entrypoint.sh`: exit 1; only the external `/spack/share/spack/setup-env.sh` SC1091 info was reported.
- `shellcheck -S warning ci/entrypoint.sh`: exit 0
- CMakePresets and unrelated baseline paths: PASS
- `spack`: unavailable; native concretization and C++23 compile remain unmeasured.

## Blocking static findings

- PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET build ARG is declared at line 512, after its ENV use at line 59; --build-arg cannot reliably configure the earlier ENV/concretization path.
- The build-time SPACK_CONCRETIZE_ENV block normalizes PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET but never sets PHLEX_LLVM_TARGET; spack.yaml therefore defaults arm64 LLVM targets to x86 during concretization.
- Native host/target ARCHITECTURE_CHECK begins at line 514, after SPACK_CONCRETIZE_ENV at line 285; mismatch rejection is too late to prevent wrong-architecture concretization.

########################################################################
# Prepare workspace directory writable by the developer group

RUN <<'PREP_DEV_WORKSPACE'
set -euo pipefail

# Prepare workspace directory writable by the developer group
mkdir -p /workspaces
chgrp $SPACK_GROUP /workspaces
chmod g+rwX /workspaces
PREP_DEV_WORKSPACE

########################################################################
# Install GitHub's act CLI for local workflow testing

ARG INSTALL_ACT=true
ARG INSTALL_ACT_ARM64=true

RUN <<'INSTALL_ACT'
set -euo pipefail

# Install GitHub's act CLI for local workflow testing
# Download architecture-specific binary: Linux_amd64 or Linux_arm64

if [ "${INSTALL_ACT}" != "true" ]; then
  echo "act installation disabled via --build-arg INSTALL_ACT=false"
  exit 0
fi

ARCH=$(dpkg --print-architecture)
ARCHIVE=""
case "$ARCH" in
  amd64)
    ARCHIVE="Linux_x86_64"
    ;;
  arm64)
    if [ "${INSTALL_ACT_ARM64}" != "true" ]; then
      echo "act arm64 installation disabled via --build-arg INSTALL_ACT_ARM64=false"
      exit 0
    fi
    ARCHIVE="Linux_arm64"
    ;;
  *)
    echo "ERROR: Unsupported architecture '$ARCH' for act download" >&2
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

download_url=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/nektos/act/releases/latest | \
  grep -Ee "\"browser_download_url\": .*/act_${ARCHIVE}\\." | \
  cut -d '"' -f 4)
if [ -z "$download_url" ]; then
  echo "Failed to determine act download URL for architecture '$ARCH' (expected format: $ARCHIVE)" >&2
  exit 1
fi
curl -sfSL "$download_url" | tar -C /usr/local/bin -zx act
chmod +x /usr/local/bin/act
INSTALL_ACT

########################################################################
# Install GitHub CLI (gh)
```

### Static acceptance findings: 0 blocking findings (was 2)

#### Fixed: Spack environment concretization now sources target normalization

ARG PHLEX_LLVM_TARGET=auto

    exit 1

case "$PHLEX_LLVM_SOURCE_TARGET" in
  auto|x86|AArch64) ;;
  *)
    echo "ERROR: PHLEX_LLVM_TARGET must be 'auto', 'x86', or 'AArch64'" >&2
    echo "       Got: '$PHLEX_LLVM_SOURCE_TARGET'" >&2
    exit 1

esac
case "$PHLEX_DEFAULT_COMPILER" in
  gcc|clang) ;;
  *)
    echo "ERROR: PHLEX_DEFAULT_COMPILER must be 'gcc' or 'clang'" >&2
    echo "       Got: '$PHLEX_DEFAULT_COMPILER'" >&2
    exit 1
    ;;
esac
ARCH_MAP_VALIDATE

RUN <<'ARCHITECTURE_CHECK'
set -euo pipefail

# Validate that the container build host architecture matches the requested SPACK target
# This check runs early, before any Spack clone/install/concretization operations
NATIVE_ARCH=$(dpkg --print-architecture)
case "$NATIVE_ARCH" in
  amd64)
    if [ "$PHLEX_SPACK_SOURCE_TARGET" != "amd64" ] && [ "$PHLEX_SPACK_SOURCE_TARGET" != "x86_64_v3" ]; then
      echo "ERROR: Host architecture '$NATIVE_ARCH' does not match PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET='$PHLEX_SPACK_SOURCE_TARGET'" >&2
      echo "       CI images must be built for the host architecture" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    # Normalize amd64 to x86_64_v3 for Spack
    normalized_spack_target=x86_64_v3
    normalized_llvm_target=x86
    ;;
  arm64)
    if [ "$PHLEX_SPACK_SOURCE_TARGET" != "arm64" ] && [ "$PHLEX_SPACK_SOURCE_TARGET" != "aarch64" ]; then
      echo "ERROR: Host architecture '$NATIVE_ARCH' does not match PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET='$PHLEX_SPACK_SOURCE_TARGET'" >&2
      echo "       CI images must be built for the host architecture" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    # Normalize arm64 to aarch64 for Spack
    normalized_spack_target=aarch64
    normalized_llvm_target=AArch64
    ;;
  *)
    echo "ERROR: Unknown host architecture '$NATIVE_ARCH'" >&2
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

if [ "$PHLEX_LLVM_SOURCE_TARGET" != "auto" ] &&
   [ "$PHLEX_LLVM_SOURCE_TARGET" != "$normalized_llvm_target" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: Host architecture '$NATIVE_ARCH' does not match PHLEX_LLVM_TARGET='$PHLEX_LLVM_SOURCE_TARGET'" >&2
  echo "       Expected LLVM target '$normalized_llvm_target' for PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET='$PHLEX_SPACK_SOURCE_TARGET'" >&2
  exit 1
fi

# RUN layers do not retain shell exports. Persist normalized values for later
# Spack operations instead of relying on Docker layer state.
printf 'export PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET=%q\nexport PHLEX_LLVM_TARGET=%q\n' \
  "$normalized_spack_target" "$normalized_llvm_target" > /etc/profile.d/phlex-targets.sh
chmod 644 /etc/profile.d/phlex-targets.sh

    cmake \

apt autoremove -y

rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

mkdir -p /opt/spack-stage /opt/spack-cache/downloads /opt/spack-cache/misc /opt/spack-environments
chgrp -R spack /spack /opt/spack-stage /opt/spack-cache /opt/spack-environments
chmod -R g+rwX /spack /opt/spack-stage /opt/spack-cache /opt/spack-environments

#!/bin/bash

# Disable Spack's user scope to prevent user-level config interference
export SPACK_USER_CONFIG_PATH=/dev/null
export SPACK_DISABLE_LOCAL_CONFIG=true

if [ -f /etc/profile.d/phlex-targets.sh ]; then
  . /etc/profile.d/phlex-targets.sh
fi

: "${PHLEX_SPACK_ENV:=/opt/spack-environments/phlex-ci}"
# PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET must be normalized to x86_64_v3 or aarch64 (Dockerfile handles this)
# Default is x86_64_v3 for backward compatibility
: "${PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET:=x86_64_v3}"
# CI images use GCC as default; developer images use Clang with GCC 15 toolchain for reproducible gcc@15 ABI
: "${PHLEX_DEFAULT_COMPILER:=gcc}"

# Validate PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET is normalized (x86_64_v3 or aarch64)
# Dockerfile normalizes amd64->x86_64_v3 and arm64->aarch64 before this runs
case "$PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET" in
  x86_64_v3)
    : "${PHLEX_LLVM_TARGET:=x86}"
    ;;
  aarch64)
    : "${PHLEX_LLVM_TARGET:=AArch64}"
    ;;
  *)
    echo "ERROR: PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET must be 'x86_64_v3' or 'aarch64'" >&2
    echo "       Got: '$PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET'" >&2
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

# Validate that SPACK target and LLVM target are compatible (no x86_64_v3 + AArch64, no aarch64 + x86)
case "$PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET-$PHLEX_LLVM_TARGET" in
  x86_64_v3-AArch64|aarch64-x86)
    echo "ERROR: Host/target mismatch: PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET=$PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET with PHLEX_LLVM_TARGET=$PHLEX_LLVM_TARGET" >&2
    exit 1
    ;;
  *)
    # Valid combinations: x86_64_v3+x86, aarch64+AArch64
    ;;
esac

case "$PHLEX_DEFAULT_COMPILER" in
  gcc|clang) ;;
  *)
    echo "ERROR: PHLEX_DEFAULT_COMPILER must be 'gcc' or 'clang'" >&2
    echo "       Got: '$PHLEX_DEFAULT_COMPILER'" >&2
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

. /spack/share/spack/setup-env.sh
spack env activate -d "$PHLEX_SPACK_ENV"

# GCC 15 is required for Phlex and its direct dependencies.
# The Spack view's 'bin' directory contains symlinks to the active compiler.
# When PHLEX_DEFAULT_COMPILER is "gcc", use GCC 15 directly via PATH.
# When PHLEX_DEFAULT_COMPILER is "clang", use Clang with reproducible --gcc-toolchain binding.
if [ "$PHLEX_DEFAULT_COMPILER" = "gcc" ]; then
  # Developer can override CC/CXX via environment; CI uses explicit --target mapping
  # GCC 15 must be used for phlex, root, and their dependencies to share ABI.
  # The spack env activate makes gcc@15 available from the Spack view.
  PATH=$(spack -E location -i gcc@15 %c,cxx=gcc@13)/bin:$PATH
  export CC=gcc CXX=g++
else
  # clang/clang++ with reproducible --gcc-toolchain binding to GCC 15
  # This preserves the GCC 15 ABI while allowing compilation via Clang.
  # The --gcc-toolchain option ensures Clang uses GCC 15's libstdc++ and headers.
  gcc_path=$(spack location -i gcc@15 %c,cxx=gcc@13)
  export CC=clang CXX=clang++
  export CFLAGS="--gcc-toolchain=$gcc_path"
  export CXXFLAGS="--gcc-toolchain=$gcc_path"
fi
```

from pathlib import Path

repo = Path('.')
dockerfile = (repo / 'ci/Dockerfile').read_text()
spack_yaml = (repo / 'ci/spack.yaml').read_text()
packages_yaml = (repo / 'ci/packages.yaml').read_text()
entrypoint = (repo / 'ci/entrypoint.sh').read_text()

SPACK_EXPR = '${PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET:-x86_64_v3}'
LLVM_EXPR = '${PHLEX_LLVM_TARGET:-x86}'

def require(haystack: str, needle: str, label: str) -> None:
    if needle not in haystack:
        raise SystemExit(f'MISSING:{label}:{needle}')

def render_descriptor(text: str, *, expected_spack: int, expected_llvm: int, spack_target: str, llvm_target: str, label: str) -> str:
    spack_count = text.count(SPACK_EXPR)
    llvm_count = text.count(LLVM_EXPR)
    if spack_count != expected_spack:
        raise SystemExit(
            f'COUNT:{label}:{SPACK_EXPR}:expected={expected_spack}:actual={spack_count}'
        )
    if llvm_count != expected_llvm:
        raise SystemExit(
            f'COUNT:{label}:{LLVM_EXPR}:expected={expected_llvm}:actual={llvm_count}'
        )
    rendered = text.replace(SPACK_EXPR, spack_target).replace(LLVM_EXPR, llvm_target)
    if SPACK_EXPR in rendered:
        raise SystemExit(f'UNRESOLVED:{label}:{SPACK_EXPR}')
    if LLVM_EXPR in rendered:
        raise SystemExit(f'UNRESOLVED:{label}:{LLVM_EXPR}')
    return rendered

def map_targets(native_arch: str, spack_source: str, llvm_source: str = 'auto') -> tuple[str, str]:
    valid_spack_sources = {'amd64', 'arm64', 'x86_64_v3', 'aarch64'}
    valid_llvm_sources = {'auto', 'x86', 'AArch64'}
    if spack_source not in valid_spack_sources:
        raise ValueError(f'invalid spack source: {spack_source}')
    if llvm_source not in valid_llvm_sources:
        raise ValueError(f'invalid llvm source: {llvm_source}')
    if native_arch == 'amd64':
        if spack_source not in {'amd64', 'x86_64_v3'}:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Host architecture '{native_arch}' does not match PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET='{spack_source}'"
            )
        normalized_spack = 'x86_64_v3'
        normalized_llvm = 'x86'
    elif native_arch == 'arm64':
        if spack_source not in {'arm64', 'aarch64'}:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Host architecture '{native_arch}' does not match PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET='{spack_source}'"
            )
        normalized_spack = 'aarch64'
        normalized_llvm = 'AArch64'
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown host architecture '{native_arch}'")
    if llvm_source != 'auto' and llvm_source != normalized_llvm:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Host architecture '{native_arch}' does not match PHLEX_LLVM_TARGET='{llvm_source}'"
        )
    return normalized_spack, normalized_llvm

# Track-template counts remain architecture-neutral

tracked_counts = {
    'ci/spack.yaml:PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET': spack_yaml.count(SPACK_EXPR),
    'ci/spack.yaml:PHLEX_LLVM_TARGET': spack_yaml.count(LLVM_EXPR),
    'ci/packages.yaml:PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET': packages_yaml.count(SPACK_EXPR),
    'ci/packages.yaml:PHLEX_LLVM_TARGET': packages_yaml.count(LLVM_EXPR),
}
expected_counts = {
    'ci/spack.yaml:PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET': 1,
    'ci/spack.yaml:PHLEX_LLVM_TARGET': 2,
    'ci/packages.yaml:PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET': 1,
    'ci/packages.yaml:PHLEX_LLVM_TARGET': 0,
}
for key, expected in expected_counts.items():
    actual = tracked_counts[key]
    if actual != expected:
        raise SystemExit(f'COUNT:{key}:expected={expected}:actual={actual}')

# Static Dockerfile contract checks

require(dockerfile, 'ENV PHLEX_SPACK_SOURCE_TARGET=${PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET}', 'raw-spack-carrier')
require(dockerfile, 'ENV PHLEX_LLVM_SOURCE_TARGET=${PHLEX_LLVM_TARGET}', 'raw-llvm-carrier')
require(dockerfile, "ARG PHLEX_LLVM_TARGET=auto", 'llvm-auto-default')
require(dockerfile, "case \"$PHLEX_DEFAULT_COMPILER\" in", 'compiler-validation')
require(dockerfile, "COPY packages.yaml /tmp/packages.yaml.template", 'packages-template-copy')
require(dockerfile, "render_target_descriptor /tmp/packages.yaml.template /tmp/packages.yaml 1 0", 'packages-render')
require(dockerfile, "spack config --scope site add -f /tmp/packages.yaml", 'packages-config')
require(dockerfile, "COPY spack.yaml /tmp/spack.yaml.template", 'spack-template-copy')
require(dockerfile, "render_target_descriptor /tmp/spack.yaml.template /tmp/spack.yaml 1 2", 'spack-render')
require(dockerfile, "spack --timestamp env create -d \"$PHLEX_SPACK_ENV\" /tmp/spack.yaml", 'spack-env-create')
require(dockerfile, "spack mirror add --type binary phlex-ci-scisoft <https://scisoft.fnal.gov/scisoft/spack-packages/phlex-dev>", 'mirror')
require(dockerfile, "curl -fsSL -o tracebox <https://get.perfetto.dev/tracebox>", 'tracebox')
require(dockerfile, 'ARCHIVE="Linux_x86_64"', 'act-amd64')
require(dockerfile, 'ARCHIVE="Linux_arm64"', 'act-arm64')
require(dockerfile, 'llvm@22.1.8 +zstd +llvm_dylib +link_llvm_dylib ~lldb targets="${PHLEX_LLVM_TARGET}"', 'llvm-install-target')
require(dockerfile, '%c,cxx=gcc@15', 'gcc15-abi')
require(entrypoint, 'case "$PHLEX_DEFAULT_COMPILER" in', 'entrypoint-compiler-validation')
require(entrypoint, 'export CFLAGS="--gcc-toolchain=$gcc_path"', 'clang-toolchain')

clone_index = dockerfile.index('git clone <https://github.com/spack/spack.git> /spack')
validate_index = dockerfile.index('ARCH_MAP_VALIDATE')
arch_check_index = dockerfile.index('ARCHITECTURE_CHECK')
if not (validate_index < clone_index and arch_check_index < clone_index):
    raise SystemExit('ORDER:architecture validation must precede Spack clone')
if entrypoint.index('case "$PHLEX_DEFAULT_COMPILER" in') > entrypoint.index('. /spack/share/spack/setup-env.sh'):
    raise SystemExit('ORDER:entrypoint compiler validation must precede Spack setup')

print('tracked-template-counts:')
for key in sorted(tracked_counts):
    print(f'  {key}={tracked_counts[key]}')

cases = [
    ('amd64-defaults', 'amd64', 'amd64', 'auto', 'gcc', 'x86_64_v3', 'x86'),
    ('amd64-normalized', 'amd64', 'x86_64_v3', 'x86', 'gcc', 'x86_64_v3', 'x86'),
    ('arm64-defaults', 'arm64', 'arm64', 'auto', 'gcc', 'aarch64', 'AArch64'),
    ('arm64-normalized', 'arm64', 'aarch64', 'AArch64', 'gcc', 'aarch64', 'AArch64'),
]
print('render-matrix:')
for label, native_arch, spack_source, llvm_source, compiler, expected_spack, expected_llvm in cases:
    normalized_spack, normalized_llvm = map_targets(native_arch, spack_source, llvm_source)
    if (normalized_spack, normalized_llvm) != (expected_spack, expected_llvm):
        raise SystemExit(
            f'MAP:{label}:expected={(expected_spack, expected_llvm)}:actual={(normalized_spack, normalized_llvm)}'
        )
    rendered_spack = render_descriptor(
        spack_yaml,
        expected_spack=1,
        expected_llvm=2,
        spack_target=normalized_spack,
        llvm_target=normalized_llvm,
        label=f'{label}:ci/spack.yaml',
    )
    rendered_packages = render_descriptor(
        packages_yaml,
        expected_spack=1,
        expected_llvm=0,
        spack_target=normalized_spack,
        llvm_target=normalized_llvm,
        label=f'{label}:ci/packages.yaml',
    )
    if normalized_spack not in rendered_spack or normalized_llvm not in rendered_spack:
        raise SystemExit(f'RENDER:{label}:ci/spack.yaml missing normalized values')
    if normalized_spack not in rendered_packages:
        raise SystemExit(f'RENDER:{label}:ci/packages.yaml missing normalized spack value')
    if compiler not in {'gcc', 'clang'}:
        raise SystemExit(f'COMPILER:{label}:invalid compiler for matrix')
    print(
        f'  {label}: source=({spack_source},{llvm_source}) normalized=({normalized_spack},{normalized_llvm}) '
        f'spack.yaml=ok packages.yaml=ok compiler={compiler}'
    )

failure_cases = [
    ('mismatch-host-spack', 'amd64', 'arm64', 'auto', "Host architecture 'amd64' does not match PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET='arm64'"),
    ('mismatch-host-llvm', 'arm64', 'arm64', 'x86', "Host architecture 'arm64' does not match PHLEX_LLVM_TARGET='x86'"),
    ('invalid-compiler', None, None, None, "PHLEX_DEFAULT_COMPILER must be 'gcc' or 'clang'"),
]
print('failure-matrix:')
for label, native_arch, spack_source, llvm_source, expected in failure_cases:
    if label == 'invalid-compiler':
        if "PHLEX_DEFAULT_COMPILER must be 'gcc' or 'clang'" not in dockerfile:
            raise SystemExit('COMPILER:missing Dockerfile compiler failure')
        if "PHLEX_DEFAULT_COMPILER must be 'gcc' or 'clang'" not in entrypoint:
            raise SystemExit('COMPILER:missing entrypoint compiler failure')
        print(f'  {label}: ok -> {expected}')
        continue
    try:
        map_targets(native_arch, spack_source, llvm_source)
    except ValueError as exc:
        message = str(exc)
        if message != expected:
            raise SystemExit(f'FAILCASE:{label}:expected={expected}:actual={message}')
        print(f'  {label}: ok -> {message}')
    else:
        raise SystemExit(f'FAILCASE:{label}:expected failure but mapping succeeded')

print('compiler-defaults:')
print('  ci-stage default compiler arg: gcc')
print('  dev-stage default compiler arg: clang')
print('  dev-stage explicit override to gcc: supported via stage-local ARG + ENV passthrough')
print('native-spack: unavailable (spack command absent on host; no Docker/Spack execution performed)')
print('native-cxx23: unavailable (no Docker/Spack/C++23 runtime execution in this step)')

        raise SystemExit(f'UNRESOLVED:{label}:{SPACK_EXPR}')
    if LLVM_EXPR in rendered:
        raise SystemExit(f'UNRESOLVED:{label}:{LLVM_EXPR}')
    return rendered

def map_targets(native_arch: str, spack_source: str, llvm_source: str = 'auto') -> tuple[str, str]:
    valid_spack_sources = {'amd64', 'arm64', 'x86_64_v3', 'aarch64'}
    valid_llvm_sources = {'auto', 'x86', 'AArch64'}
    if spack_source not in valid_spack_sources:
        raise ValueError(f'invalid spack source: {spack_source}')
    if llvm_source not in valid_llvm_sources:
        raise ValueError(f'invalid llvm source: {llvm_source}')
    if native_arch == 'amd64':
        if spack_source not in {'amd64', 'x86_64_v3'}:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Host architecture '{native_arch}' does not match PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET='{spack_source}'"
            )
        normalized_spack = 'x86_64_v3'
        normalized_llvm = 'x86'
    elif native_arch == 'arm64':
        if spack_source not in {'arm64', 'aarch64'}:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Host architecture '{native_arch}' does not match PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET='{spack_source}'"
            )
        normalized_spack = 'aarch64'
        normalized_llvm = 'AArch64'
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown host architecture '{native_arch}'")
    if llvm_source != 'auto' and llvm_source != normalized_llvm:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Host architecture '{native_arch}' does not match PHLEX_LLVM_TARGET='{llvm_source}'"
        )
    return normalized_spack, normalized_llvm

tracked_counts = {
    'ci/spack.yaml:PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET': spack_yaml.count(SPACK_EXPR),
    'ci/spack.yaml:PHLEX_LLVM_TARGET': spack_yaml.count(LLVM_EXPR),
    'ci/packages.yaml:PHLEX_SPACK_TARGET': packages_yaml.count(SPACK_EXPR),

}
for key, expected in expected_counts.items():

        raise SystemExit(f'COUNT:{key}:expected={expected}:actual={actual}')

```
#!/bin/bash

# Ensure auxiliary repositories exist on the host as siblings of the phlex
# repository.  Called by devcontainer.json initializeCommand before the
# container is created, so that bind mounts always have a valid source path.
#
# If a repository is already present its existing content is left untouched,
# preserving local branches and uncommitted changes.  If a clone fails the
# directory is still created so the mount succeeds, and setup-repos.sh can
# retry the clone from inside the container.

# Do not use set -e: clone failures are handled explicitly and must not abort
# the whole script, as that would prevent the container from starting.
set -uo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
PARENT_DIR="$(cd "${SCRIPT_DIR}/../.." && pwd)"

# --- CLI options ---
MODE="default"
START_TEST_SERVICES=""
SELF_TEST_DIR=""
CLEANUP_OWNED=""

for arg in "$@"; do
  case "$arg" in
    --start-test-services=*)
      START_TEST_SERVICES="${arg#*=}"
      MODE="start-test-services"
      ;;
    --self-test=*)
      SELF_TEST_DIR="${arg#*=}"
      MODE="self-test"
      ;;
    --cleanup-owned)
      CLEANUP_OWNED="1"
      MODE="cleanup-owned"
      ;;
    *)
      echo "ERROR: unknown option: $arg" >&2
      exit 1
      ;;
  esac
done

# --- Relay configuration ---
PHLEX_RELAY_STATE_DIR="${PHLEX_RELAY_STATE_DIR:-$HOME/.phlex-devcontainer-tmp/relays}"
if [[ "$MODE" == "self-test" ]]; then
  PHLEX_RELAY_STATE_DIR="${SELF_TEST_DIR}/relay-state"
fi
mkdir -p "$PHLEX_RELAY_STATE_DIR"

RELAY_MAP_JSON="${PHLEX_RELAY_STATE_DIR}/relay-map.json"
RELAY_MAP_ENV="${PHLEX_RELAY_STATE_DIR}/relay-map.env"
RELAY_PID_DIR="${PHLEX_RELAY_STATE_DIR}/pids"
mkdir -p "$RELAY_PID_DIR"

# Default exports (updated if relays are configured)
export PHLEX_HOST_GATEWAY="host.docker.internal"
export PHLEX_HOST_RELAY_FILE="$RELAY_MAP_JSON"
export PHLEX_HOST_RELAYS_ENV="$RELAY_MAP_ENV"
export PHLEX_PODMAN_SOCKET_SOURCE="podman-machine"
export PHLEX_RELAY_STATE_DIR

# --- Helper functions ---

clone_if_absent() {
  local repo=$1
  local dest="${PARENT_DIR}/${repo}"

  if [ -e "${dest}/.git" ]; then
    echo "Repository already present: ${dest}"
    return 0
  fi

  if [ -d "${dest}" ] && [ -n "$(ls -A "${dest}" 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
    echo "WARNING: ${dest} exists and is non-empty but not a git repository; skipping" >&2
    return 0
  fi

  mkdir -p "${dest}"

  echo "Cloning Framework-R-D/${repo} into ${dest} ..."
  local max_tries=3 current_try=0
  while ! git clone --depth 1 "https://github.com/Framework-R-D/${repo}.git" "${dest}"; do
    (( ++current_try ))
    echo "Attempt ${current_try}/${max_tries} to clone ${repo} from GitHub FAILED" >&2
    if (( current_try >= max_tries )); then
      echo "WARNING: unable to clone ${repo} to ${dest}; an empty directory was created" >&2
      return 0
    fi
    rm -rf "${dest}"
    mkdir -p "${dest}"
    sleep 5
  done
}

ensure_bind_dir() {
  mkdir -p "$@"
}

# start_socat_relay LABEL KILL_PATTERN LISTEN_SPEC CONNECT_SPEC LOGFILE READY_TEST
#
# Start a background socat relay, waiting up to 2 s for it to become ready.
start_socat_relay() {
  local label="$1"
  local kill_pattern="$2"
  local listen_spec="$3"
  local connect_spec="$4"
  local logfile="$5"
  local ready_test="$6"

  if ! command -v socat >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "WARNING: socat not found; cannot start ${label} relay" >&2
    return 1
  fi

  pkill -f "${kill_pattern}" 2>/dev/null || true
  sleep 0.2

  echo "Starting ${label} relay: ${listen_spec} -> ${connect_spec} ..."
  if command -v setsid >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    nohup setsid socat "${listen_spec}" "${connect_spec}" > "${logfile}" 2>&1 &
  else
    nohup socat "${listen_spec}" "${connect_spec}" > "${logfile}" 2>&1 &
  fi

  local i=0
  while [ "${i}" -lt 20 ]; do
    eval "${ready_test}" 2>/dev/null && break
    sleep 0.1
    i=$(( i + 1 ))
  done

  if eval "${ready_test}" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "${label} relay ready"
    return 0
  else
    echo "WARNING: ${label} relay did not become ready in time" >&2
    return 1
  fi
}

# detect_listener SOURCE_PORT - check if port is listening on loopback
# Returns 0 if listening, 1 otherwise
detect_listener() {
  local source_port="$1"

  if [[ "$OSTYPE" == "darwin"* ]]; then
    # Darwin: use lsof for precise listener detection
    if command -v lsof >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      lsof -i :${source_port} -P -n 2>/dev/null | grep -qE "127\.0\.0\.1:${source_port}|::1:${source_port}" && return 0
    fi
  else
    # Linux: use ss for listener detection
    if command -v ss >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null | grep -qE "(127\.0\.0\.1|::1):${source_port} " && return 0
    fi
  fi

  return 1
}

# is_pid_owned_by_us PIDFILE SOURCE_PORT DEST_PORT - verify PID file ownership
# Returns 0 if PID file is owned by this relay script, 1 otherwise
is_pid_owned_by_us() {
  local pidfile="$1"
  local source_port="$2"
  local dest_port="$3"

  if [ ! -f "$pidfile" ]; then
    return 1
  fi

  local stored_pid
  stored_pid=$(cat "$pidfile" 2>/dev/null) || return 1

  if [ -z "$stored_pid" ]; then
    return 1
  fi

  if ! kill -0 "$stored_pid" 2>/dev/null; then
    return 1
  fi

  # Check command identity via /proc/pid/cmdline
  if [[ -f "/proc/${stored_pid}/cmdline" ]]; then
    local cmdline
    cmdline=$(tr '\0' ' ' < "/proc/${stored_pid}/cmdline" 2>/dev/null)
    if [[ "$cmdline" =~ socat.*TCP.*${source_port} ]] || [[ "$cmdline" =~ socat.*${source_port} ]]; then
      return 0
    fi
  fi

  # Darwin fallback: try lsof to verify process is socat relaying this port
  if [[ "$OSTYPE" == "darwin"* ]] && command -v lsof >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    if lsof -p "$stored_pid" -P -n 2>/dev/null | grep -q socat; then
      return 0
    fi
  fi

  return 1
}

# Cleanup function for exit
cleanup_relays() {
  for pidfile in "${PHLEX_RELAY_STATE_DIR}/pids"/*; do
    if [ -f "$pidfile" ]; then
      local source_port
      source_port=$(basename "$pidfile")
      cleanup_owned_process "$pidfile" "$source_port"
    fi
  done
}

# cleanup_owned_process PIDFILE SOURCE_PORT - clean only owned processes
cleanup_owned_process() {
  local pidfile="$1"
  local source_port="$2"

  if [ ! -f "$pidfile" ]; then
    return 0
  fi

  local stored_pid
  stored_pid=$(cat "$pidfile" 2>/dev/null) || return 0

  if [ -z "$stored_pid" ]; then
    rm -f "$pidfile"
    return 0
  fi

  # Verify PID file is owned by us before killing
  if is_pid_owned_by_us "$pidfile" "$source_port" ""; then
    if kill -0 "$stored_pid" 2>/dev/null; then
      kill "$stored_pid" 2>/dev/null || true
      sleep 0.1
      if kill -0 "$stored_pid" 2>/dev/null; then
        kill -9 "$stored_pid" 2>/dev/null || true
      fi
    fi
  fi

  rm -f "$pidfile"
}

# start_relay SOURCE_PORT DEST_PORT - start a single relay with proper binding
start_relay() {
  local source_port="$1"
  local dest_port="$2"

  local relay_bind_addr
  local listen_spec
  local connect_spec

  if [[ "$OSTYPE" == "darwin"* ]]; then
    # Darwin: bind to 127.0.0.1 explicitly for --net=pasta compatibility
    relay_bind_addr="127.0.0.1:${dest_port}"
    listen_spec="TCP-LISTEN:${relay_bind_addr},fork,reuseaddr"
  else
    # Linux: bind to 0.0.0.0 for container reachability via host.containers.internal
    relay_bind_addr="0.0.0.0:${dest_port}"
    listen_spec="TCP-LISTEN:${dest_port},fork,reuseaddr"
  fi

  connect_spec="TCP:127.0.0.1:${source_port}"
  local kill_pattern="socat.*${source_port}"
  local logfile="${PHLEX_RELAY_STATE_DIR}/relay-${source_port}-${dest_port}.log"

  echo "Starting host relay: 127.0.0.1:${source_port} -> ${relay_bind_addr}"
  if command -v setsid >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    nohup setsid socat "$listen_spec" "$connect_spec" > "$logfile" 2>&1 &
  else
    nohup socat "$listen_spec" "$connect_spec" > "$logfile" 2>&1 &
  fi
  local pid=$!

  # Store PID with command identity (for cleanup verification)
  echo "$pid" > "${RELAY_PID_DIR}/${source_port}"

  # Verify relay is listening
  sleep 0.2

  local ready=false
  if [[ "$OSTYPE" == "darwin"* ]]; then
    if command -v lsof >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      lsof -i :${dest_port} -P -n 2>/dev/null | grep -qE "127\.0\.0\.1:${dest_port}" && ready=true
    fi
  else
    if command -v ss >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null | grep -qE ":${dest_port} " && ready=true
    fi
  fi

  if $ready; then
    echo "Host relay $source_port -> $dest_port ready"
    return 0
  else
    echo "WARNING: host relay $source_port -> $dest_port did not start in time" >&2
    cleanup_owned_process "${RELAY_PID_DIR}/${source_port}" "$source_port"
    return 1
  fi
}

# write_relay_maps - write deterministic sorted JSON and env maps
write_relay_maps() {
  # Sort by source port for deterministic output
  local -a sorted_source=()
  local -a sorted_dest=()

  if [ -n "${valid_source_ports[*]-}" ]; then
    # Create pairs for sorting
    local -a pairs=()
    local source_count=0
    if [ -n "${valid_source_ports[*]-}" ]; then
      source_count=${#valid_source_ports[@]}
    fi
    for ((i = 0; i < source_count; i++)); do
      pairs+=("${valid_source_ports[$i]}:${valid_dest_ports[$i]}")
    done

    # Sort pairs
    local -a sorted_pairs=()
    while IFS= read -r pair; do
      sorted_pairs+=("$pair")
    done < <(printf '%s\n' "${pairs[@]}" | sort -t: -k1 -n)

    for pair in "${sorted_pairs[@]}"; do
      sorted_source+=("${pair%%:*}")
      sorted_dest+=("${pair#*:}")
    done
  fi

  # Write JSON map
  if [ -n "${sorted_source[*]-}" ]; then
    local json_content="{"
    local first=true
    for source in "${sorted_source[@]}"; do
      local idx=0
      for s in "${sorted_source[@]}"; do
        if [ "$s" = "$source" ]; then
          break
        fi
        ((idx++))
      done
      local dest="${sorted_dest[$idx]}"

      if $first; then
        first=false
      else
        json_content+=", "
      fi
      json_content+="\"${source}\": \"${dest}\""
    done
    json_content+="}"
    echo "$json_content" > "$RELAY_MAP_JSON"
  else
    echo '{}' > "$RELAY_MAP_JSON"
  fi

  # Write env map
  if [ -n "${sorted_source[*]-}" ]; then
    local env_content=""
    local sorted_count=0
    if [ -n "${sorted_source[*]-}" ]; then
      sorted_count=${#sorted_source[@]}
    fi
    for ((i = 0; i < sorted_count; i++)); do
      env_content+="PHLEX_HOST_RELAY_${sorted_source[$i]}=${sorted_dest[$i]}"$'\n'
    done
    printf '%s' "$env_content" > "$RELAY_MAP_ENV"
  else
    : > "$RELAY_MAP_ENV"
  fi
}

# mode_default - standard execution with PHLEX_HOST_RELAY_PORTS
mode_default() {
  echo "Running in default mode with PHLEX_HOST_RELAY_PORTS"

  if [ -n "${PHLEX_HOST_RELAY_PORTS:-}" ]; then
    if ! parse_and_validate_relays "$PHLEX_HOST_RELAY_PORTS"; then
      write_relay_maps
      return 1
    fi

    local -a ready_source_ports=()
    local -a ready_dest_ports=()
    local source_count=0
    if [ -n "${valid_source_ports[*]-}" ]; then
      source_count=${#valid_source_ports[@]}
    fi
    for ((i = 0; i < source_count; i++)); do
      if start_relay "${valid_source_ports[$i]}" "${valid_dest_ports[$i]}"; then
        ready_source_ports+=("${valid_source_ports[$i]}")
        ready_dest_ports+=("${valid_dest_ports[$i]}")
      fi
    done
    valid_source_ports=("${ready_source_ports[@]-}")
    valid_dest_ports=("${ready_dest_ports[@]-}")

    write_relay_maps

    export PHLEX_HOST_RELAY_FILE="$RELAY_MAP_JSON"
    export PHLEX_HOST_RELAYS_ENV="$RELAY_MAP_ENV"
  else
    echo "No PHLEX_HOST_RELAY_PORTS configured; using defaults"
    valid_source_ports=()
    valid_dest_ports=()
    write_relay_maps
  fi
}

# mode_self_test - run self-test in external directory
mode_self_test() {
  local test_dir="$SELF_TEST_DIR"
  local failed=0

  assert_valid_count() {
    local expected="$1"
    local actual=0
    if [ -n "${valid_source_ports[*]-}" ]; then
      actual=${#valid_source_ports[@]}
    fi
    if [ "$actual" -ne "$expected" ]; then
      echo "ERROR: expected $expected valid mappings, got $actual" >&2
      return 1
    fi
  }

  if [ ! -d "$test_dir" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: self-test directory does not exist: $test_dir" >&2
    exit 1
  fi

  echo "Running self-test in: $test_dir"

  # Create test relay state directory
  local test_state_dir="${test_dir}/relay-state"
  mkdir -p "$test_state_dir/pids"

  # Override globals for test mode
  RELAY_MAP_JSON="${test_state_dir}/relay-map.json"
  RELAY_MAP_ENV="${test_state_dir}/relay-map.env"
  RELAY_PID_DIR="${test_state_dir}/pids"

  # Start disposable listeners on the two allowlisted source ports.
  echo "Setting up test listeners on 25114 and 25300..."
  local fakelistener
  fakelistener() {
    local port=$1
    python3 -c "
import socket, time
s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
s.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
s.bind(('127.0.0.1', $port))
s.listen(1)
time.sleep(5)
" 2>/dev/null &
  }
  fakelistener 25114
  fakelistener 25300
  sleep 0.5

  # Test 1: Positive case - valid mappings
  echo "Test 1: Valid relay mappings (25114=25115,25300=25301)"
  parse_and_validate_relays "25114=25115,25300=25301"
  local valid_count=${#valid_source_ports[@]}
  echo "  Valid pairs found: $valid_count (expected 2)"
  assert_valid_count 2 || failed=1

  # Test 2: Malformed input
  echo "Test 2: Malformed input (non-numeric and ports < 1024)"
  valid_source_ports=()
  valid_dest_ports=()
  parse_and_validate_relays "abc=def,123=456"
  echo "  Valid pairs found: ${#valid_source_ports[@]} (expected 0)"
  assert_valid_count 0 || failed=1

  # Test 3: Duplicate source
  echo "Test 3: Duplicate source port (25114=25115,25114=25116)"
  valid_source_ports=()
  valid_dest_ports=()
  parse_and_validate_relays "25114=25115,25114=25116"

  valid_source_ports=()
  valid_dest_ports=()
  parse_and_validate_relays "80=8080,1024=11024"

# mode_cleanup_owned - cleanup only processes owned by this relay system
mode_cleanup_owned() {
  echo "Cleaning up owned relay processes"

  if [ ! -d "$RELAY_PID_DIR" ]; then
    echo "No PID directory found: $RELAY_PID_DIR"
    exit 0
  fi

  for pidfile in "$RELAY_PID_DIR"/*; do
    if [ -f "$pidfile" ]; then
      local source_port
      source_port=$(basename "$pidfile")
      cleanup_owned_process "$pidfile" "$source_port"
    fi
  done

  # Clean up empty PID directory
  rmdir "$RELAY_PID_DIR" 2>/dev/null || true

  echo "Cleanup completed"

HEADROOM_AZURE_PORT="${HEADROOM_AZURE_PORT:-9797}"

relay_headroom_port() {
  local role="$1"
  local proxy_port="$2"
  local relay_port=$(( proxy_port + 10000 ))
  local local_addr="127.0.0.1:${proxy_port}"

  if ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null | grep -q "127.0.0.1:${proxy_port}"; then
    start_socat_relay \
      "Headroom ${role} proxy" \
      "socat TCP-LISTEN:${relay_port}" \
      "TCP-LISTEN:${relay_port},fork,reuseaddr" \
      "TCP:${local_addr}" \
      "/tmp/socat-headroom-${role}.log" \
      "ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null | grep -q ':${relay_port} '" || true
  else
    echo "WARNING: headroom ${role} proxy not detected at ${local_addr}; skipping relay" >&2
    echo "  Ensure the SSH tunnel is active (headroom-${role} running on your laptop)" >&2
  fi
